svg.title: Junior Forest Warden / Canadian Forestry Ass’n. — photo-registered vector study
svg.desc: Editable paths traced and reconstructed against the supplied photograph. The shield, inset rim, individual lettering and maple leaf retain photographed asymmetry and perspective. Broad relief edges are simplified; grain, cast shadows and JPEG noise are omitted. This is not authenticated issue artwork or a rectified manufacturing die. Metal badge with a worn copper tone. Alloy and plating are unverified.
svg.metadata: {"occurrenceId":"S01-O01","sourceId":"S01","sourceUrl":"https://drive.google.com/file/d/1INS_YP_UZWb3HuuJuolLxhmbafQ2Fo_W/view","sourceSha256":"ccff597d5eefc59ddee05a70690de332b3a1844921a5ac9b2652a9e241544f09","sourceDimensions":[720,960],"bbox":[65,125,604,732],"registration":{"type":"photo crop translation only","translate":[-65,-125],"perspectiveCorrection":false},"method":"Manually observed cubic silhouette and rim, individually drawn ridge-centreline lettering with explicit relief/face widths, and five-lobe leaf with corrected lobe recesses and connected tapered veins; no fonts, image-derived texture paths, or embedded raster","quality":"Photo-registered vector reconstruction; fine relief remains interpreted","materialAttribution":"Metal badge, worn copper tone; alloy and plating unverified","captionRuns":[{"id":"junior","text":"• JUNIOR •","glyphCount":6},{"id":"forest-warden","text":"FOREST WARDEN","glyphCount":12},{"id":"canadian","text":"CANADIAN","glyphCount":8},{"id":"forestry-assn","text":"FORESTRY ASS’N.","glyphCount":13}],"limits":["Perspective and curvature retained from one photograph; not a frontal die master.","Fine glyph boundaries and veins are softened by the photograph and interpreted.","Flat warm colours are display choices, not a calibrated material measurement."]}
